about: Metal's full player with the peek (his call A, 2026-10-21; metal.md): the grid's square is the cover, the 5:4 box drawn around it, the square at most 72 % of the card's width (--fp-cover-share). Four window sizes; each probe measures the cover against the band, the scrubber and the card. Run in lilac-metal and lilac-glass (Glass must be unchanged: share 1).

steps.probe: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.bento[data-player="full"] .panel[data-slot="np"]'); const q = (s) => p.querySelector(s)?.getBoundingClientRect(); const v = q('.np__art > .vinyl'), a = q('.np__art'), s = q('.np__scrub'), m = q('.np__meta') || q('.np__center'), c = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const r = (b) => b && [Math.round(b.left), Math.round(b.width), Math.round(b.height)]; return { rows: p.dataset.npRows, stack: document.querySelector('[data-fp-stack]') ? 1 : 0, card: r(c), box: r(a), cover: r(v), band: r(m), scrub: r(s), coverSquare: !!v && Math.abs(v.width - v.height) < 2, bandMatchesCover: !!(v && m) && Math.abs(v.left - m.left) < 2 && Math.abs(v.width - m.width) < 2, boxInCard: !!a && a.left >= c.left - 1 && a.right <= c.right + 1 }; })()

steps.name: drum
steps.probe: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.bento[data-player="full"] .panel[data-slot="np"] .np__art'); const v = a?.querySelector(':scope > .vinyl')?.getBoundingClientRect(); const ps = [...(a?.querySelectorAll('.metal-peek:not([data-empty])') ?? [])].map((p) => p.getBoundingClientRect()); if (!v || !ps.length) return { sides: 0 }; const past = ps.map((b) => Math.round(Math.max(v.left - b.left, b.right - v.right))); return { sides: ps.length, cover: Math.round(v.width), P: a.style.getPropertyValue('--metal-perspective'), past, pastShare: past.map((x) => Math.round((1000 * x) / v.width) / 1000), noWedge: ps.every((b) => b.top >= v.top - 1 && b.bottom <= v.bottom + 1), peekAsStage: past.every((x) => x / v.width > 0.035) }; })()
